article_title: Don't fall for this - how to protect yourself from AI scams

tasks.prompt: What is the article's main purpose?
options: To warn consumers about AI-assisted scams and explain how to protect themselves
To teach retailers how to create AI advertising images
To compare the prices of British and Chinese products
To recommend new voice-cloning applications
tasks.correct_answer: To warn consumers about AI-assisted scams and explain how to protect themselves
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מזהירה מפני הונאות המשתמשות בבינה מלאכותית ומציעה צעדי הגנה מעשיים לצרכנים.

tasks.prompt: What may happen after someone orders from one of the fake retailer websites described?
options: The buyer automatically receives a refund.
The product may never arrive or may be a cheap mass-produced item.
The website sends the buyer to a genuine High Street shop.
The seller provides free financial advice.
tasks.correct_answer: The product may never arrive or may be a cheap mass-produced item.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי גורמי תקני המסחר, המוצר עלול לא להגיע כלל או להתברר כפריט זול שיוצר בייצור המוני.

tasks.prompt: What does “impersonate” mean when scammers use cloned voices?
options: To investigate someone's identity
To report someone to the police
To pretend to be another person
To translate a person's message
tasks.correct_answer: To pretend to be another person
tasks.explanation_hebrew: impersonate פירושו להתחזות לאדם אחר; כאן משתמשים בקול או בווידאו מזויפים כדי להיראות כבן משפחה או חבר.

tasks.prompt: What does “supercharge scams” suggest in the opening sentence?
options: AI makes scams legal.
AI removes all financial risk.
AI limits scams to online shops.
AI makes scams faster, more convincing or easier to produce at scale.
tasks.correct_answer: AI makes scams faster, more convincing or easier to produce at scale.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: supercharge משמש כאן במשמעות של העצמה משמעותית: הבינה המלאכותית מאפשרת ליצור הונאות משכנעות ובהיקף גדול יותר.

tasks.prompt: Why are spelling mistakes less useful than before for identifying scams?
options: AI can generate polished messages without obvious language errors.
All genuine companies now use informal spelling.
Scammers are required to employ professional editors.
Trading standards no longer examine written messages.
tasks.correct_answer: AI can generate polished messages without obvious language errors.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מסבירה שכלי AI יכולים ליצור הודעות דיוג אישיות וללא שגיאות, ולכן אי אפשר עוד להסתמך על שגיאות כתיב ודקדוק.

tasks.prompt: Which action does the article recommend before trusting a business or offer?
options: Pay quickly before the offer expires.
Trust a company if its website shows British flags.
Send a gift card to confirm your identity.
Check the address, authorisation or advert directly through reliable sources.
tasks.correct_answer: Check the address, authorisation or advert directly through reliable sources.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מומלץ לבדוק כתובת, להשתמש ב־FCA Firm Checker כשמתאים, וליצור קשר ישיר עם העסק כדי לאמת הצעה או מודעת עבודה.

tasks.prompt: Name three AI-enabled scam techniques listed in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלוש טכניקות קונקרטיות מתוך הכתבה, ולא תיאורים כלליים של הונאה.
expected_points: Rapidly created cloned or new websites that look polished and professional.
Romance scams that use AI to remember personal details and sustain conversations.
Deepfake videos or cloned voices that imitate relatives or friends asking for emergency money.
Personalised, error-free phishing emails, texts or social-media posts produced at scale.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the article's advice for checking whether a request or offer is genuine.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול עצירה וחשיבה, מחקר עצמאי, פנייה ישירה, אי־הסתמכות על קול/וידאו והימנעות מהעברת כסף או מידע לאדם שלא פגשנו.
expected_points: Pause before paying, sharing information or acting, especially when there is pressure or urgency.
Research the organisation, address or regulator independently.
Contact the business directly to verify job adverts or other claims.
Do not assume a voice or video proves identity, and do not send money or sensitive information to someone not met in person.

tasks.prompt: Why do pressure and urgency help scammers, according to the article?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהלחץ מצמצם זמן לבדיקה ומעודד תגובה רגשית ומהירה לפני אימות זהות או פרטים.
expected_points: Urgency pushes a potential victim to act before thinking carefully.
It reduces the time available to check an address, company or person's identity.
An emergency story can trigger fear or concern, especially when a familiar voice or face is imitated.
Stopping and verifying independently interrupts the scammer's intended process.

tasks.prompt: Write a short public warning using the words “genuine”, “urgency” and “impersonate”.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשתמש נכון בשלוש המילים, להציע צעד אימות מעשי ולשמור על ניסוח קצר וברור.
expected_points: Use all three required words accurately.
Explain that a convincing voice, video or website may not be genuine.
Warn that scammers create urgency and may impersonate trusted people.
Recommend pausing and verifying through an independent contact method.
